title: Minimax Brackets for the Marginal Total-Variation Treatment Effect under Confounding
banked_reason: Validity-gate confirmed terminal downgrade: sound endpoint-and-bracket companion, but selected sharp simultaneous joint frontier undelivered after bounded root attempt; achieved incremental below field floor.
gap_reasons: The full-class bracket does not determine the joint alphabet price: at d asymptotic to n and k asymptotic to n/log²(en), its lower scale is log⁻²(en), whereas its available upper scale remains constant.
faithful rewriting cannot supply the missing joint result.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved endpoint reductions and brackets, complete energy identities, and normalized grouped certificates, then attempted the joint attaining construction. The specified unlocalized composition failed its sufficient energy screen; no matching joint estimator or converse was delivered. The public scalar predecessor owns the logarithmic gap closure, and outcome-localized joint attainment remains open; this is not an all-estimator impossibility result.
tldr:
This is an endpoint-and-bracket companion for the causal marginal total-variation effect. The proved supplied-propensity and one-confounder-label risks have order \(r_Y(n,k)\); the binary-outcome risk has order \(r_X(n,d)\). The signed scalar logarithmic-gap closure is credited to the public CausalSmith predecessor, rather than claimed as this note's new contribution. A public coordinate reduction improves the full-class upper bracket to \(\min\{1,k/n+(d/n)^2,k^2r_X\}\), against the all-procedure lower floor \(r_{\mathrm{add}}\).

The sharp simultaneous frontier remains open. At the grouped stress point the proved high-degree lower certificate has \(\Delta^2\asymp\log^{-3}(\mathrm e n)\), below the additive \(\log^{-2}(\mathrm e n)\) floor. A fully specified logarithmic-degree composition has exponentially large complete derivative energy even at equal marginals; this defeats that certificate without establishing an interaction lower bound.
gap: The closest published results separate nonsmooth direct categorical distance from scalar causal adjustment. Their decisive variance and moment-mixture steps concern different experiments. No inspected theorem certifies a joint unknown-denominator, marginal absolute-value frontier on the unrestricted two-alphabet class.
fill: The main question requires an explicit all-regime risk order, public tuning and observable attainment, and an all-procedure lower bound. A shared-denominator vector approximation, full polynomial derivative energy, and normalized grouped subexperiments give concrete starting objects. The supplied-propensity comparison retains the identical estimand and class. The grouped-converse milestone fixes \(h\asymp n/\log^2(\mathrm e n)\), \(s\asymp\log^2(\mathrm e n)\), and a one-block likelihood-divergence budget, with target separation and concentration derived on legal normalized laws.
